title: Migrate MindWave launch to the AppCore WebView2 launcher

decisions.text: Config location: MindWaveCore/server/app.cfg (mirrors KKLeftRight); AppMain auto-loads it when placed next to the exe.
BunExe = .\bun.exe (pin the bundled bun; matches launcher.bat's local-first preference).
Mode=prod, FullScreen=true (kiosk launch); dev mode documented in the cfg comments (Mode=dev -> quasar 9000 + backend 3300).
Reuse AppCore's prebuilt AppMain.exe + libwebview.dll (AppCore/build/win_x64/bin); do not fork/rebuild AppCore. Copy them into server/ so AppMain auto-loads app.cfg.
No server/quasar change for prod serving: quasar distDir already = server/public and the server serves public/; quasar dev proxy already targets 3300 for /api + /ws/ui.
Process: plan + ledger; per-step atomic commits (step-id prefixed); NO push; approval gate before bundling binaries / retiring the launcher; launch is a manual/visual gate.

OPEN (approval AP0.2): (a) commit-vs-sync for the copied AppMain.exe + libwebview.dll (default sync-only, gitignored, copied by a script -- like worker-packaging WP-D3); (b) retire vs keep server/launcher.bat (default: keep as documented fallback, AppCore primary).

steps.title: Plan & ledger
steps.verify: ledger JSON parses; dependsOn DAG acyclic; plan + ledger committed
evidence: Grounded in code: AppCore = FPC WebView2 launcher (AppMain.exe -config app.cfg, prebuilt bin present); KKLeftRight keeps AppMain+app.cfg+libwebview in server/. MindWave fits: port 3300, quasar distDir=server/public (server serves it), dev proxy /api+/ws/ui->3300, dev URL 9000, bundled server/bun.exe, current launcher server/launcher.bat.
DAG acyclic: AP0.1 -> AP1.1 (app.cfg) ; AP0.1 -> AP0.2 (approval) -> AP1.2 -> {AP2.1, AP2.2} -> AP3.1.

steps.title: Write server/app.cfg
steps.verify: app.cfg has the AppCore keys with MindWave values (Mode=prod, BunExe=.\bun.exe, ServerDir=., UiDir=..\ui, ServerPort=3300, DevUrl=9000, BuildUi=true, FullScreen=true); ports match server.ts (3300) + quasar dev proxy
evidence: Wrote MindWaveCore/server/app.cfg modeled on KKLeftRight/server/app.cfg with MindWave values: Mode=prod, BunExe=.\bun.exe, ServerDir=., UiDir=..\ui, ServerPort=3300, DevUrl=http://localhost:9000/, BuildUi=true, FullScreen=true, ReadyTimeoutSec=90. Ports verified against server.ts getPort default (3300) and quasar devServer proxy (/api + /ws/ui -> 3300).
Prod path is already wired (quasar distDir=server/public; server serves public/), so BuildUi=true + start serves the built UI on 3300 with no extra changes.

steps.title: Approval gate (AP-D7)
steps.verify: owner confirms (a) commit-vs-sync for AppMain.exe/libwebview.dll and (b) retire-vs-keep launcher.bat; decisions locked. PAUSE before AP1.2.
evidence: Owner locked AP-D7: (a) AppMain.exe + libwebview.dll are SYNC-ONLY (gitignored, copied by a script); (b) server/launcher.bat is KEPT as a fallback (AppCore is the primary launch).

steps.title: Bundle AppMain.exe + libwebview.dll into server/
steps.verify: AppMain.exe + libwebview.dll copied from AppCore/build/win_x64/bin into server/ (next to app.cfg); binaries handled per AP-D7a; AppMain auto-loads app.cfg
evidence: sync-appcore-launcher.ps1 copies AppMain.exe + libwebview.dll from Games/AppCore/build/win_x64/bin into server/. Ran it: both synced; server/ now holds app.cfg + AppMain.exe + libwebview.dll (+ launcher.bat fallback).

server/.gitignore extended with AppMain.exe + libwebview.dll (sync-only, alongside bun.exe). git add -n stages only .gitignore + sync-appcore-launcher.ps1; the binaries are ignored. AppMain auto-loads the sibling app.cfg -> launches MindWave.
AP2.1/AP2.2 (prod/dev launch) are MANUAL/visual gates (WebView2 + desktop session) -> to be run by the owner.

steps.title: Verify prod launch (manual)
steps.verify: AppMain (auto-load app.cfg) -> UI builds -> backend on 3300 -> webview opens http://localhost:3300/; audio/spectrogram usable

steps.title: Verify dev launch (manual)
steps.verify: Mode=dev -> quasar dev 9000 + backend 3300; webview opens http://localhost:9000/ with /api + /ws/ui proxied

steps.title: Retire/adjust launcher.bat + README
steps.verify: AppCore documented as the primary launch; launcher.bat kept-as-fallback or removed per AP-D7b

log.note: AppCore-launch plan + ledger created. Migrate MindWave launch to AppCore (AppMain.exe -config app.cfg), mirroring KKLeftRight. Grounded: prebuilt AppMain present; port 3300; quasar build->server/public already wired; dev proxy->3300; local bun.exe.

Wrote MindWaveCore/server/app.cfg (Mode=prod, BunExe=.\bun.exe, ServerDir=., UiDir=..\ui, ServerPort=3300, DevUrl=9000, BuildUi=true, FullScreen=true). Ports match server.ts (3300) + quasar dev proxy. Next: AP0.2 approval gate (AP-D7) before bundling AppMain binaries.

AP-D7 locked: sync-only binaries + keep launcher.bat fallback. sync-appcore-launcher.ps1 copies AppMain.exe+libwebview.dll into server/ (done); .gitignore keeps them sync-only. server/ has app.cfg+AppMain.exe+libwebview.dll; AppMain auto-loads app.cfg. Remaining AP2.1/2.2 = MANUAL launch verification (owner); AP3.1 = README doc.
